description: Bosun-style Grafana dashboard for Data-Juicer bytedance.metrics call sites. Rate-counter metrics emitted via emit_rate_counter are rendered directly; do not enable Grafana compute-rate on them, otherwise values are double-rated and look too small.

panels.description: Rate-counter metric emitted by emit_vlm_qps. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate. Tags: job_id, op_name, target, method, status.
panels.title: VLM 请求速率（status/op/target/method）

panels.description: VLM API error request rate. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate. Source: vlm_api_response_mapper.
panels.title: VLM 错误速率

panels.description: Rate-counter metric for VLM adaptive rate-limit events: 429, retry, exhausted, penalty, recovery. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: VLM Rate Limit 事件速率

panels.description: Store metric for configured/effective VLM RPM/TPM values. The metric tag distinguishes configured_rpm/configured_tpm/effective_rpm/effective_tpm.
panels.title: VLM Rate Limit 当前值

panels.description: Rate-counter metric emitted by emit_rpc_qps. Current call sites include image_ocr_mapper, aweme_pack_url_mapper, item_id_image_url_mapper, and video_url_rpc_mapper. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: RPC 请求速率（status/op/target/method）

panels.description: RPC-style operator error rate. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: RPC 错误速率

panels.description: Focused rate-counter view for image_ocr_mapper RPC traffic. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: OCR RPC 速率

panels.description: Focused rate-counter view for schema RPC traffic, especially item_id_image_url_mapper. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: Schema RPC 速率

panels.description: Focused rate-counter view for aweme_pack_url_mapper PackImage RPC traffic. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: Aweme Pack RPC 速率

panels.description: Focused rate-counter view for video_url_rpc_mapper SmartPlayer MGetPlayInfosV2 RPC traffic. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: Video URL RPC 速率

panels.description: Rate-counter metric emitted by download_file_mapper and s3_download_file_mapper for each attempted input URL/path. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate. URL values are intentionally not used as tags.
panels.title: 下载请求QPS（status/op/scheme/save_mode）

panels.description: Failed download rate grouped by operator, URL scheme, and save mode. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: 下载失败速率

panels.description: Per-file successful download byte count. Uses content length when in-memory bytes are available, otherwise saved file size.
panels.title: 下载总流量

panels.description: Per-file successful download byte count. Uses content length when in-memory bytes are available, otherwise saved file size.
panels.title: 下载平均大小

panels.description: Per-file download latency in milliseconds, including local file reads and remote/S3 download attempts.
panels.title: 下载平均耗时 ms

panels.description: Rate-counter metric emitted by download_file_mapper for retry and timeout events. event=retry counts a scheduled next attempt; event=timeout counts each timed-out attempt. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate.
panels.title: 下载事件速率（retry/timeout）

panels.description: Rate-counter metric emitted by emit_dedup_rows. event=eligible means rows entering the dedup condition, unique means representative rows kept, and duplicate means rows dropped by dedup. Render directly without Grafana compute-rate; use runtime custom_stats or export summary for cumulative counts.
panels.title: Dedup 行数速率（event/op/field）

panels.description: Overview of Data-Juicer rate-counter metric families plus VLM rate-limit, download store, and dedup metrics. Rate-counter targets are rendered directly without Grafana compute-rate. Use tags to filter by job_id, op_name, target, method, status, model, event, scheme, save_mode, field_key, and backend.
panels.title: 全部 Data-Juicer 外发打点速率总览

title: Data-Juicer Metrics
